Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

sla_onsite.text: CORU's operational, regulatory and strategic requirements. 3.3 Key Requirements Of The Website Hosting & Support Service 1. Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. CORU's website is currently hosted on the Umbraco Content Management System (CMS). Tenderers should indicate whether they propose to retain the existing CMS o

Be fully supported and regularly updated by the provider and software vendor. 9 2. Hosting Services The successful tenderer shall provide a managed hosting service for the CORU website. The proposed hosting solution shall: • Be hosted within the European Union, with hosting in Ireland preferred. • Be secure, resilient and scalable. • Support high availability and business continuity requirements. Include proactive monitoring and management of the hosting environment. • Include automated notifications and alerting for outages, service degradation, security incidents or attempted attacks. • Maintain a minimum service availability commitment of 99.9% excluding agreed scheduled maintenance periods. Tenderers shall provide details of: • Hosting location(s). • Primary and secondary hosting facilities and data centres. • Backup arrangements and retention periods. • Disaster recovery arrangements. references_experience.text:
The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expressions of Interest will be assessed based on the follo

staffing_team.text:
igible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expressions of Interest will be assessed based on the following criteria:

  • General Experience of the Firm (core business and years in business).
  • Experience in similar assignments of compatible size, complexity and technical specialty in the required area. Experience in development partner-financed contracts will be considered an advantage.
  • Firm’s in-house staffing resources with relevant expertise (extent of relevant expertise available among the staff who are on the firm’s regular payroll). 
  • Firm’s relevant organizational capabilities for the assignment.

Key Experts will not be evaluated during the assessment of Expressions of Interest.

Consultants are requested to submit but not limited to, the following supporting documents in support of the above-mentioned criteria:

(a) The Firm's Incorporation/Trade/Registration documents from the country of the firm; (b) JV agreement/letter of intent (if applicable); (c) Firm’s brochure;

and/or of each sub-consultant for carrying out the assignment, to justify the proposed inclusion of the JV members and/or sub-consultants in the association. Failure to provide the above explanation in the Expression of Interest may affect the Consultant’s consideration for the assignment.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualification-based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 9:00 to 16:00 hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by 17:00 hours BST on 09 December 2026.

(Professor Md. Asaduzzaman)

insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers. An Autotransfusion Units also known as an autologous blood recovery system, is a system that provides hospitals with an easy-to-use, reliable way to recover a patient’s own high-quality blood during medium to high blood loss procedures, including cardiac, orthopedic, trauma, transplant, vascular and OBGYN surgeries. Once recovered, the blood is washed and delivered to a product bag. The complete system is designed to be intuitive and flexible for optimal performance, supporting exceptional patient care. Nõuded hanke raames esitatavale ideekavandile Ideekavandi eesmärk on võimaldada hankijal hinnata pakkuja võimekust luua kontserni väärtustest, visioonist ja missioonist lähtuv terviklik ja rakendatav brändilahendus. Ideekavand ei pea sisaldama kõiki tehnilises kirjelduses nõutud brändiraamatu elemente ega valmis lõppkujundusi. Pakkuja peab esitama loovlahenduse kavandi, mis hõlmab loovkontseptsiooni kirjeldust, visuaalse identiteedi esialgset kavandit, logokavandit ja selle rakendusnäiteid infokandjatel (esitlusslaid, trükis, suunaviit, digiekraan, tööriietuse ja meene näidis) ning projekti metoodikat ja koostöö korralduse kirjeldust. Tehisintellekti kasutus peab olema näidistöös viidatud. Tööprotsessi ajakava Esimene töökohtumine toimub kahe tööpäeva jooksul pärast lepingu sõlmimist. Pakkuja esitab pakkumuses oma nägemuse tööde ajakavast ja kavandite üleandmise vaheetappidest, arvestades, et tervikliku visuaalse stiili elementide ning brändiraamatu üleandmine toimub hiljemalt 31. märts 2027. ===== FILE: files/files_unpacked/316649 hindamiskriteeriumid ja metoodika.pdf ===== 1 Hindamiskriteeriumid ja metoodika 1. Konfidentsiaalsus 6.1. Lepingupooled kohustuvad hoidma saladuses teise poole kohta lepingu täitmise käigus teatavaks saanud teabe, mis ei ole avalikult kättesaadav või mille avaldamine võib kahjustada teise poole huve. 6.2. Konfidentsiaalset teavet ei tohi avaldada kolmandatele isikutele ilma teise poole eelneva kirjaliku nõusolekuta, välja arvatud juhul, kui avaldamise kohustus tuleneb õigusaktist. 6.3. Konfidentsiaalseks teabeks loetakse muu hulgas: a) patsientide, klientide, töötajate ja teiste füüsiliste isikute isikuandmeid; b) andmeid töötasu, eelarve, kulude, tulude, kasumi ja majandustegevuse kohta; c) lepinguga seotud tehnilist, ärilist ja organisatoorset informatsiooni; d) muud teavet, mis ei ole mõeldud avalikuks kasutamiseks. 6.4. Töövõtja ta gab, et tema töötajad, alltöövõtjad ja muud lepingu täitmisel kasutatavad isikud täidavad konfidentsiaalsuskohustust. 6.5. Konfidentsiaalsuskohustus k

või litsentseerimine tellijale lepingus sätestatud moel. 7.5. Kui tellijale üleantav töö sisaldab ka intellektuaalomandiõigusi, mis ei pärine algupäraselt töövõtjalt või tema heaks tegutsevatelt füüsilistelt isikutelt (nt autoriõigusega kaitstavad teosed, mille on loonud töövõtjaga mitteseotud kolmandad isikud), siis tagab töövõtja, et ta on omandanud kõik vajalikud õigused, et anda tellijale edasi sellises mahus intellektuaalomandiõigused, mis võimaldavad tellijal tööd sihtotstarbeliselt, ilma tähtajaliste piiranguteta ja ilma ühelegi kolmandale isikule tasu maksmata kasutada. 7.5.1. Töövõtja lahendab oma kulul kõik töötajate või kolmandate isikute nõuded ja vaidlused, mis tulenevad intellektuaalomandi õigustest. 7.5.2. Kui sellise nõude või vaidluse tõttu tekib tellijale kahju, kulu või muu kohustus, hüvitab töövõtja selle tellijale täies ulatuses. 8. Vastutus 8.1. Teenuse või selle mistahes osa juhusliku hävimise või kahjustumise riisiko tellijale üleminek loetakse toimunuks arve esitamise aluseks oleva vastava töö üleandmis -vastuvõtmis akti allkirjastamisest arvates. 8.2. Kohustust rikkunud lepingupool hüvitab teisele poolele rikkumisega põhjustatud otsese kahju ning juhul, kui rikkumine puudutab konfidentsiaalsust, isikuandmete kaitset või intellektuaalse oman

eabe (nt ärisaladus majandustegevuse, materjalide, infosüsteemide kohta). Konfidentsiaalsuskohustus takistab kõrvaliste isikute juurdepääsu teabele, mis võib kahjustada asutuse tegevust, huve, mainet või isikute eraelu puutumatust. Seetõttu tuleb hoolikalt kaaluda, kuidas, kus ja kellega räägitakse asutusega seotud teemadel, vältimaks kõrvaliste isikute juurdepääsu asutuse jaoks tundlikule infole. Partner peab täitma kõiki sellise teabe konfidentsiaalsena hoidmiseks vajalikke nõudeid, v.a, kui teabe avaldamine on õigusaktiga lubatud või nõutav. Kui teabel on märge “konfidentsiaalne” või “asutusesiseseks kasutamiseks” ei või teavet kolmandatele isikutele avaldada. Konfidentsiaalsuskohustus jääb kehtima ka pärast koostöö lõppu. 6/6 3.4. Partner käitub koostöös erapooletult ning ei võimalda teistele isikutele lubamatuid eeliseid. Partner ei sõlmi suhteid, millest võib tuleneda tegelik või näiline vastuolu asutuse huvidega või mis võiksid avaldada halba mõju partneri enda tegevus - või otsustusvabadusele. Partner ei kasuta koostöösuhte tõttu saadud teavet või asutuse vara isikliku kasu saamiseks. 3.5. Vahetu koostöö käigus ei viibi partner joovastavate ainete mõju all. ip_data_security.text: nboarding the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) to the National Eye Institute’s (NEI) existing OpenSpecimen biobanking software instance and implementing associated Electronic Medical Record (EMR) integration services. Competition is restricted to Krishagni LLC because NHLBI’s requirement is specifically to onboard to NEI’s active, Krishagni-licensed and operated OpenSpecimen environment rather than to procure a separate standalone biobanking system. Acquiring a different biobanking product would not satisfy the requirement to join the existing NEI shared instance and would result in substantial duplication of software licensing, implementation, validation, and support infrastructure costs, as well as unacceptable operational delays. As the software developer, proprietor, and operator of the existing NEI OpenSpecimen environment, Krishagni LLC is the only responsible source authorized and technically capable of performing the required onboarding, workflow configuration, and EMR integration services within that shared platform. Requirements/Salient Characteristics: The following specification lists the minimum requirements for a lock-in amplifier. Objective requirements are also highlighted when available. A lock-in amplifier is crucial for separating laser photodetector outputs from noise that may otherwise drown out the signal. Therefore, this lock-in component is necessary for meeting mission requirements. 3.1. The lock-in amplifier shall meet the following technical requirements: 3.1.1. Demodulation capability for DC up to 600 megahertz or higher reference signals 3.1.2. At least two analog BNC inputs 3.1.3. At least two analog BNC outputs 3.1.4. Analog to digital input conversion capability included, along with the inverse of digital to analog output conversion 3.1.5. Minimum sampling rate for input data of 1.25 giga-samples per second (GSa/s) 3.1.6. USB 2.0 or USB-C interface is supported 3.1.7. PC software interface included 3.1.8. Coding support for either Python or MATLAB languages 3.1.8.1. API for supported language must be given 3.1.9. Come with a manufacturer’s warranty of at least 1 year 3.1.10. Signal output must support digital to analog conversion of at least 1.25 giga-s
